## Problem and resulting behavior

What concrete problem does this change solve? What will a user observe afterward?

## Validation

Commands or real session checks, environment/version, actual results and untested scope. For a workflow change, include the relevant input and before/after behavior. Review agent-generated changes before submitting.

## Compatibility and docs

Affected entrypoints, task/recovery formats and migration needs, if any. Update matching EN/ZH documentation when behavior changes. Explain any new integration's maintenance owner, costs and failure/recovery behavior.

## Media and rights (when applicable)

Author/source links, project and actual Skill version if known, display/redistribution permission, significant manual fixes and capture method. Identify concepts, work in progress and offline rendering. Confirm that no credentials, signed URLs, private records, unrelated assets or caches are included.
